description:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Interceptor

Initially designed as Aegis’ frontline carrier ship for the military, the Avenger Stalker took a different path, ultimately having a long and storied career as the standard patrol craft of the UEE Advocacy. Utilizing its cargo hold for prisoner transport, the Avenger features a sturdy, reliable hull and the capacity for larger-than-expected engine mounts.

game_description.de_DE:
Hersteller: Aegis Dynamics
Fokus (En): Interceptor
Fokus (De): Abfangjäger

Ursprünglich als Aegis-Trägerschiff für das Militär konzipiert, schlug die Avenger Stalker einen anderen Weg ein und erlebte schließlich eine lange und erfolgreiche Karriere als Standard-Patrouillenschiff der UEE Advocacy. Die Avenger nutzt ihren Frachtraum für den Transport von Gefangenen und verfügt über einen robusten, zuverlässigen Rumpf und die Möglichkeit, größere Antriebe als erwartet zu montieren.
game_description.en_EN: Initially designed as Aegis' frontline carrier ship for the military, the Avenger Stalker took a different path, ultimately having a long and storied career as the standard patrol craft of the UEE Advocacy. Utilizing its cargo hold for prisoner transport, the Avenger features a sturdy, reliable hull and the capacity for larger-than-expected engine mounts.
game_description.fr_FR:
Fabricant : Aegis Dynamics
Type : Interdiction

Initialement conçu comme le navire porte-avions de première ligne d'Aegis pour l'armée, l'Avenger Stalker a emprunté une autre voie, connaissant finalement une longue et riche carrière en tant que patrouilleur standard de l'UEE Advocacy. Utilisant sa soute à cargaison pour le transport de prisonniers, l'Avenger arbore une coque robuste et fiable et la capacité d'accueillir des montages moteurs plus imposants que prévu.
game_description.zh_CN:
制造商：圣盾动力（Aegis Dynamics）
定位：截击

复仇者最早的设计初衷是作为圣盾的军用前线舰载机，然而复仇者追猎走上了一条完全不同的道路，最终成为了充满故事的UEE治安专用巡逻飞船。复仇者追猎将货舱改造成了囚犯运输仓，并且拥有坚固可靠的船体和超出预期大小的引擎。

name: Aegis Avenger Stalker

description:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Light Freight 

Lacking the Prisoner Cells of the Stalker or the EMP Generator of the Warlock, the Titan’s hold is free to carry cargo. Couple that available space with the Avenger’s tried and true combat abilities and you’ve got a light cargo hauler that’s more than capable of handling itself in a fight.

game_description.de_DE:
Hersteller: Aegis Dynamics
Fokus (En): Light Freight
Fokus (De): Frachter (leicht)

Ohne die Gefangenenzellen der Stalker oder dem EMP-Generator der Warlock ist der Laderaum der Titan frei, um Fracht zu transportieren. Kombiniert man diesen verfügbaren Platz mit den bewährten Kampffähigkeiten der Avenger, erhält man einen leichten Frachter, der sich in einem Kampf mehr als behaupten kann.
game_description.en_EN: Lacking the Prisoner Cells of the Stalker or the EMP Generator of the Warlock, the Titan's hold is free to carry cargo. Couple that available space with the Avenger's tried and true combat abilities and you've got a light cargo hauler that's more than capable of handling itself in a fight.
game_description.fr_FR:
Fabricant : Aegis Dynamics
Type : Cargaison légère

À défaut des cellules de prisonniers du Stalker ou du générateur EMP du Warlock, la soute du Titan est libre de transporter du fret. Associez cet espace disponible aux capacités de combat éprouvées de l’Avenger et vous obtenez un transporteur léger de fret plus que capable de se débrouiller en combat.
game_description.zh_CN:
制造商：圣盾动力（Aegis Dynamics）
定位：轻型货船 

没有装备追猎者的囚犯运输仓或者术士的EMP产生器，泰坦的空间用来随意装载货物。将泰坦的货运能力和复仇者的战斗能力结合起来，你就得到了一个可以在战斗中游刃有余的轻型货船。

description:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Light Freight

Created as part of the ‘Masters of Flight’ series in conjunction with the flight-sim Arena Commander, the Renegade pays tribute to famed pilot Danny Solomon for his notable work with the Advocacy to bring justice to Bremen. This Avenger Titan comes equipped with a specialized dogfighting focused loadout and a custom special edition livery honoring this iconic ship.

game_description.de_DE:
Hersteller: Aegis Dynamics
Fokus (En): Light Freight
Fokus (De): Frachter (leicht)

Die Renegade wurde als Teil der "Masters of Flight"-Serie in Verbindung mit der Flugsimulation Arena Commander entwickelt und zollt dem berühmten Piloten Danny Solomon Tribut für seine bemerkenswerte Arbeit mit der Advocacy, um Bremen Gerechtigkeit widerfahren zu lassen. Die Avenger Titan ist mit einer speziellen, auf den Luftkampf ausgerichteten Ausrüstung und einer Sonderlackierung ausgestattet, die dieses ikonische Schiff ehrt.
game_description.en_EN: Created as part of the 'Masters of Flight' series in conjunction with the flight-sim Arena Commander, the Renegade pays tribute to famed pilot Danny Solomon for his notable work with the Advocacy to bring justice to Bremen. This Avenger Titan comes equipped with a specialized dogfighting focused loadout and a custom special edition livery honoring this iconic ship.
game_description.fr_FR:
Fabricant : Aegis Dynamics
Type : Light Freight

Créé dans le cadre de la série ‘Masters of Flight’ en collaboration avec le simulateur de vol Arena Commander, le Renegade rend hommage au célèbre pilote Danny Solomon pour son travail notable avec l’Advocacy afin d’apporter la justice à Bremen. Cet Avenger Titan est équipé d’un chargement axé sur le combat aérien et d’une livrée spéciale édition personnalisée en l’honneur de ce vaisseau emblématique.
game_description.zh_CN:
制造商：圣盾动力（Aegis Dynamics）
定位：轻型货运

为了纪念著名飞行员丹尼·所罗门与督导局合作，为不莱梅带去了公平正义，‘飞行大师’剧组和飞行模拟游戏竞技场指挥官的合作，创造了复仇者 泰坦变节者。复仇者泰坦变节者装备了专门为狗斗设计的武器配置以及一个特殊的皮肤。

name: Aegis Avenger Titan Renegade

description:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Interdiction

The Avenger Warlock was built towards a single design philosophy: stop ships, don’t destroy them. Probably the closest to a non-lethal fighter, the Warlock is outfitted with a Behring REP-8 EMP Generator, capable of emitting a powerful electromagnetic wave to disable any electronics unfortunate enough to be within the blast radius.

game_description.de_DE:
Hersteller: Aegis Dynamics
Fokus (En): Interdiction
Fokus (De): Abfangen

Die Avenger Warlock wurde nach einer einzigen Konstruktionsphilosophie konstruiert: Schiffe aufhalten, nicht zerstören. Die Warlock, die einem nicht-tödlichen Jäger wohl am nächsten kommt, ist mit einem Behring REP-8 EMP-Generator ausgestattet, der eine starke elektromagnetische Welle aussenden kann, die jede Elektronik außer Gefecht setzt, die sich unglücklicherweise im Strahlungsradius befindet.
game_description.en_EN: The Avenger Warlock was built towards a single design philosophy: stop ships, don't destroy them. Probably the closest to a non-lethal fighter, the Warlock is outfitted with a Behring REP-8 EMP Generator, capable of emitting a powerful electromagnetic wave to disable any electronics unfortunate enough to be within the blast radius.
game_description.fr_FR:
Fabricant : Aegis Dynamics
Type : Interdiction

L'Avenger Warlock a été conçu selon une philosophie de conception unique : arrêter les vaisseaux, sans les détruire. Probablement le plus proche d'un chasseur non létal, le Warlock est équipé d'un Générateur EMP REP-8 Behring, capable d'émettre une puissante onde électromagnétique pour désactiver toute l'électronique située dans le rayon d'explosion.
game_description.zh_CN:
制造商：圣盾动力（Aegis Dynamics）
定位：拦阻

复仇者术士的设计理念只有一个：截停舰船，而不是摧毁它们。复仇者术士类似于非致命战斗机，它装备着一个贝林REP-8 EMP发生器，可以释放出一个强力的电磁脉冲以使得范围内的电子设备失去能力。

Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Stealth Bomber

The Aegis Eclipse is a bomber designed to get in and strike before it's ever even spotted. After extensive service with the UEE, this high-tech military equipment made its civilian market debut in 2947.

game_description.de_DE:
Hersteller: Aegis Dynamics
Fokus (En): Stealth Bomber
Fokus (De): Tarnkappenbomber

Die Aegis Eclipse ist ein Bomber, die angreift, bevor sie überhaupt gesichtet wird. Nach ausgedehnten Einsätzen bei der UEE feierte dieses Hightech-Militärgerät 2947 ihr Debüt auf dem zivilen Markt.
game_description.en_EN: The Aegis Eclipse is a bomber designed to get in and strike before it's ever even spotted. After extensive service with the UEE, this high-tech military equipment made its civilian market debut in 2947.
game_description.fr_FR:
Fabricant : Aegis Dynamics
Type : Bombardier Furtif

L'Éclipse Aegis est un bombardier conçu pour s'infiltrer et frapper avant même d'être repéré. Après une longue période de service au sein de l'UEE, cet équipement militaire de haute technologie a fait ses débuts sur le marché civil en 2947.
game_description.zh_CN:
制造商：圣盾动力（Aegis Dynamics）
定位：隐形轰炸机

圣盾日蚀轰炸机的设计理念就是在被发现之前完成进入战斗并完成打击的动作。经过在UEE广泛地服役之后，这种高科技的军用飞船终于在2947年进入民用市场。

The Gladius is an older design which has been updated over the years to keep up with modern technology. In military circles, the Gladius is beloved for its performance and its simplicity. A fast, light fighter with a laser-focus on dogfighting, the Gladius is an ideal interceptor or escort ship.

game_description.de_DE:
Hersteller: Aegis Dynamics
Fokus (En): Light Fighter
Fokus (De): Jäger (leicht)

Die Gladius ist ein älteres Modell, die im Laufe der Jahre aktualisiert wurde, um mit der modernen Technologie Schritt zu halten. In Militärkreisen wird die Gladius für ihre Leistung und ihre Einfachheit geliebt. Die Gladius ist ein schnelles, leichtes Kampfschiff, das sich auf den Nahkampf konzentriert und ein ideales Abfang- oder Begleitschiff ist.
game_description.en_EN: The Gladius is an older design which has been updated over the years to keep up with modern technology. In military circles, the Gladius is beloved for its performance and its simplicity. A fast, light fighter with a laser-focus on dogfighting, the Gladius is an ideal interceptor or escort ship.
game_description.fr_FR:
Fabricant : Aegis Dynamics
Type : Chasseur Léger

Le Gladius est un design plus ancien qui a été mis à jour au fil des années pour suivre les technologies modernes. Dans les cercles militaires, le Gladius est apprécié pour ses performances et sa simplicité. Un chasseur léger et rapide, axé sur le combat spatial rapproché, le Gladius est l'intercepteur ou le vaisseau d'escorte idéal.
game_description.zh_CN:
制造商：圣盾动力（Aegis Dynamics）
定位：轻型战斗机

短剑的设计相对古老，机体需要不断进行升级才能跟随时代的脚步。在军队的圈子里，短剑因为其性能和简洁性而深受大家喜爱。短剑作为高速轻型，以激光武器为主的狗斗机，非常适合用于拦截或者护航。

Honor the famed Captain who shaped the course of the UEE Navy's elite fighter squadron with the Dunlevy variant for the Aegis Gladius. This special ship pays to tribute to Captain Alexandra Dunlevy and Squadron 42 with red highlights against a grey base paint and military-grade components.

Created as part of the ‘Masters of Flight’ series in conjunction with the flight-sim Arena Commander, the Valiant pays tribute to famed defense pilot Condi Hillard for being the first Human on record to defeat a Vanduul in combat. This Gladius comes equipped with a specialized dogfighting focused loadout and a custom special edition livery honoring her iconic ship.

game_description.de_DE:
Hersteller: Aegis Dynamics
Fokus (En): Light Fighter
Fokus (De): Jäger (leicht)

Die Valiant wurde als Teil der "Masters of Flight"-Serie in Verbindung mit der Flugsimulation Arena Commander entwickelt und zollt der berühmten Verteidigungspilotin Condi Hillard Tribut, die als erster Mensch einen Vanduul im Kampf besiegte. Diese Gladius ist mit einer speziellen Ausrüstung für den Luftkampf und einer Sonderlackierung ausgestattet, die ihr ikonisches Schiff ehrt.
game_description.en_EN: Created as part of the 'Masters of Flight' series in conjunction with the flight-sim Arena Commander, the Valiant pays tribute to famed defense pilot Condi Hillard for being the first Human on record to defeat a Vanduul in combat. This Gladius comes equipped with a specialized dogfighting focused loadout and a custom special edition livery honoring her iconic ship.
game_description.fr_FR:
Fabricant : Aegis Dynamics
Type : Chasseur Léger

Créé dans le cadre de la série ‘Masters of Flight’ en collaboration avec le simulateur de vol Arena Commander, le Valiant rend hommage à la célèbre pilote de défense Condi Hillard pour être la première humaine enregistrée à vaincre un Vanduul au combat. Ce Gladius est équipé d'une configuration spécialisée axée sur le combat aérien et d'une livrée d'édition spéciale personnalisée rendant hommage à son vaisseau emblématique.
game_description.zh_CN:
制造商：圣盾动力（Aegis Dynamics）
定位：轻型战斗机 

短剑勇士来源于‘飞行大师’系列和飞行模拟竞技场指挥官的合作，为了纪念一位有名的国防飞行员康迪 希拉德，在官方记录中他是人类史上第一位击败剜度的飞行员。短剑勇士装备了专门为狗斗设计的武器配置以及一个特殊的用以纪念她的标志性飞船的皮肤。

A fast patrol ship with multiple turrets designed to combat fighters, the Hammerhead is equally suited to support larger capital ships in a fleet or act as a flagship for fighter groups.

game_description.de_DE:
Hersteller: Aegis Dynamics
Fokus (En): Heavy Gunship
Fokus (De): Kanonenschiff (schwer)

Ein schnelles Patrouillen-Schiff mit mehreren Geschütztürmen, das dafür ausgelegt ist, Kämpfer zu bekämpfen. Die Hammerhead eignet sich aber auch zur Unterstützung größerer Großkampfschiffe in einer Flotte oder als Flaggschiff für Jägertruppen.
game_description.en_EN: A fast patrol ship with multiple turrets designed to combat fighters, the Hammerhead is equally suited to support larger capital ships in a fleet or act as a flagship for fighter groups.
game_description.fr_FR:
Fabricant : Aegis Dynamics 
Type : Vaisseau d'Attaque Lourd

Un patrouilleur rapide doté de plusieurs tourelles conçues pour combattre des chasseurs, le Hammerhead est tout aussi adapté pour soutenir des vaisseaux capitaux plus grands dans une flotte ou faire office de vaisseau amiral pour des groupes de chasseurs.

一艘配有多个炮塔、专用于与战斗机交战的快速巡逻飞船，锤头鲨级不仅适用于支援舰队内的大型主力舰船，还能胜任小型战斗机群的旗舰。

Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Frigate

Larger than a bomber but smaller than a ship-of-the-line, frigates occupy an interesting space in the pantheon of Naval warships. While they lack the heavy armor and the capital weaponry of a cruiser, the UEE Navy prizes its frigates as they are maneuverable and can be adapted for use in a wide-range of combat scenarios.
name: Aegis Idris-M

description:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Frigate

A mark two 'peacekeeper' variant developed for the UEE patrol services, the Idris-P strips the standard ship's ship-to-ship gun and spinal mount in favor of additional cargo capacity and superior speed.

game_description.de_DE:
Hersteller: Aegis Dynamics
Fokus (En): Frigate
Fokus (De): Fregatte

Eine MkII "Peacekeeper"-Variante, die für den UEE-Patrouillendienst entwickelt wurde, entfernt die standardmäßige Schiff-zu-Schiff-Waffe und das Rückgrat-Montagesystem zugunsten zusätzlicher Ladekapazität und überlegener Geschwindigkeit.
game_description.en_EN: A mark two 'peacekeeper' variant developed for the UEE patrol services, the Idris-P strips the standard ship's ship-to-ship gun and spinal mount in favor of additional cargo capacity and superior speed.
game_description.fr_FR:
Fabricant : Aegis Dynamics
Type : Frégate

Une variante Mark II 'peacekeeper' développée pour les services de patrouille de l'UEE, l'Idris-P retire le canon internavire standard et la monture dorsale standard au profit d'une capacité de fret accrue et d'une vitesse supérieure.
game_description.zh_CN:
制造商：圣盾动力（Aegis Dynamics）
定位：护卫舰

伊德里斯“和平使者”是为了UEE巡逻组织研发的伊德利斯变体。伊德里斯-P将原本标配的反舰舰炮和龙骨炮拆除，取而代之的是更多的货物空间以及更高的速度。

description:
Manufacturer: Aegis Dynamics
Focus: Heavy Salvage

The Aegis Reclaimer is an industrial salvage ship. Equipped with a reinforced cargo bay, a long-range jump drive and launch pods for unmanned drones, the Reclaimer is an ideal ship for taking advantage of deep space wrecks. Tractor beams, floodlights, scanner options and docking ports round out the tools on this capable, utilitarian spacecraft.

game_description.de_DE:
Hersteller: Aegis Dynamics
Fokus (En): Heavy Salvage
Fokus (De): Verwertung (schwer)

Die Aegis Reclaimer ist ein industrielles Verwertungsschiff. Ausgestattet mit einem verstärkten Frachtraum, einem Langstrecken-Sprungantrieb und Startkapseln für unbemannte Drohnen ist die Reclaimer ein ideales Schiff zur Verwertung von Wracks im Weltraum. Traktorstrahlen, Flutlichter, Scanneroptionen und Andockpunkte vervollständigen die Ausstattung dieses fähigen, zweckmäßigen Raumschiffs.
game_description.en_EN: The Aegis Reclaimer is an industrial salvage ship. Tractor beams, floodlights, scanner options and docking ports round out the tools on this capable, utilitarian spacecraft.
game_description.fr_FR:
Fabricant : Aegis Dynamics
Type : Récupération Lourde

Le Reclaimer d'Aegis est un vaisseau de récupération industriel. Équipé d'une soute à cargaison renforcée, d'un propulseur de saut longue portée et de pods de lancement pour drones sans pilote, le Reclaimer est un vaisseau idéal pour profiter des épaves dans l'espace profond. Les faisceaux tracteurs, les projecteurs, les options de scanner et les ports d'amarrage complètent les outils de ce vaisseau spatial polyvalent et utilitaire.
game_description.zh_CN:
制造商：圣盾动力（Aegis Dynamics）
定位：重型打捞

圣盾回收者是一艘工业打捞船。回收者装有加强的货舱，一个长航程的跳跃驱动器以及无人机的发射仓，它非常适合处理那些深空中的残骸。这艘实用主义至上的飞船配备有牵引光束，泛光灯，扫描器和对接舱门。

description:
Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial
Focus: Anti - Air
 
Building upon a robust and sturdy industrial frame, Greycat has crafted the MDC Mobile Defense Center into an effective combat vehicle ready to protect your interests from remote mining sites to patrolling high-value processing centers thanks to its mounted PDS turret.
name: Greycat MDC

description:
Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial
Focus: Pathfinder

As an expert in industrial operations, Greycat understands that jobsite security is a vital part of any successful business venture. Not only that, but to be fully effective, you need to be able to get your security personnel and their equipment to wherever they’re needed most. That’s why the MTC Mobile Tactical Center is such an important addition to your next venture. Nimble enough to access the difficult terrain encountered at remote operations and equipped with enough suit lockers, weapon racks, and storage to tackle a wide host of issues, the Greycat MTC could make all the difference when it comes to turning a potential problem into potential profit.
name: Greycat MTC

description:
Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial
Focus: Passenger

The Greycat PTV is a simple and practical buggy frequently used to reduce travel times in large hangars or outposts.
name: Greycat PTV

description:

Focus: Light Mining

By focusing on the essentials of terrestrial-based mining, Greycat Industrial designed their hardworking, no-nonsense ROC (Remote Ore Collector) to complement the miners who use it. From its precision gimbaled mining arm to its all-terrain wheels, this solo-operated vehicle shows how important it is to have the right tool for the job.
name: Greycat ROC

description:
Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial
Focus: Light Mining

By focusing on the essentials of terrestrial-based mining, Greycat Industrial designed their hardworking, no-nonsense ROC-DS (Remote Ore Collector Dual Seat) to let mining pairs do more while in the field. The ROC-DS raises the ground-mining game by adding extra cargo capacity and a second seat to operate the precision gimbaled mining arm. Greycat even upgraded the driver's cab with a protective enclosure to allow for longer excursions in harsh conditions. With the ROC-DS, mining duos now have the right tool to comfortably collect more ore.
name: Greycat ROC-DS

description:
Manufacturer: Greycat Industrial

name: Greycat STV

description:

Focus: Passenger

The Greycat UTV is a durable, utility buggy designed to transport light cargo loads across rugged terrain. Whether you’re coordinating freight storage or making a supply run to a neighboring outpost, the straightforward design of the UTV allows operators to focus on tackling the job at hand.
name: Greycat UTV

description.de_DE: Größer als ein Bomber, aber kleiner als ein Schiff der Linie, nehmen Fregatten einen interessanten Platz im Pantheon der Kriegsschiffe ein. Während ihnen die schwere Rüstung und die Hauptwaffen eines Kreuzers fehlen, sind Fregatten manövrierfähiger und hoch konfigurierbar.

game_description.en_EN: Larger than a bomber but smaller than a ship-of-the-line, frigates occupy an interesting space in the pantheon of Naval warships. game_description.fr_FR:
Fabricant : Aegis Dynamics
Type : Frégate

Plus grand qu’un bombardier mais plus petit qu’un vaisseau de ligne, les frégates occupent un espace intéressant dans le panthéon des navires de guerre. Bien qu’elles n’aient pas l’armure lourde et l’armement lourd d’un croiseur, la Marine de l’UEE valorise ses frégates car elles sont maniables et peuvent être adaptées pour une large gamme de scénarios de combat.

Freelancers are used as long haul merchant ships by major corporations, but they are just as frequently repurposed as dedicated exploration vessels by independent captains who want to operate on the fringes of the galaxy.
name: MISC Freelancer

description:
Manufacturer: MISC
Focus: Expedition 

The Freelancer DUR variant specializes in exploration. Sacrificing 25% cargo capacity of the standard Freelancer for an enhanced jump drive, a more advanced scanner, and an expanded fuel tank may seem like a bad call to some, but those who value discovery over profit will find it to be their ship of choice.
name: MISC Freelancer DUR

Manufacturer: MISC

Freelancer variant with additional cargo capacity at the expense of weapons. The Freelancer MAX variant sacrifices weaponry for an increased cargo capacity making it ideal for equipment or raw materials transport.

Manufacturer: MISC
Focus: Gunship

The Freelancer MIS is a limited edition militarized variant of the classic mercantile ship developed by the UEE. These were produced in very small quantity due to some early payload incidents. This version sacrifices the majority of the cargo capacity to make way for missiles.
name: MISC Freelancer MIS

description:
Manufacturer: MISC
Focus: Light Freight

The smallest, most affordable Hull. The Hull A is great for those just striking out in the galaxy on their own. The Hull A is most similar to the Aurora and Mustang, but lacks the ‘jack of all trades’ nature. Where the others trade cargo capacity for firepower or speed, the Hull A is 100% on-mission transport.
name: MISC Hull A

description:
Manufacturer: MISC

name: MISC Hull B

description:
Manufacturer: MISC
Focus: Heavy Freight

Often called the most common ship in the galaxy, the Hull C is the most-produced of the range and is considered by many to be the most versatile. Intended to hit the ‘sweet spot’ between the smaller single-person transports and the massive superfreighters that make up the rest of the range, the Hull C offers the expansive modularity of the larger ships while still retaining a modicum of the maneuverability allowed the low end of the range.

All of this combines with a larger carrying capacity than many ships in its class to make the Kore a natural choice for short-range hauling, or with the simple addition of a few optional components, this can-do ship can do anything you dream of.
name: MISC Reliant Kore

Perfect for the aspiring explorer who wants to whisper their name into the halls of history.

name: MISC Reliant Tana
